title: Is Kylie Kelce Ready for Baby No. 5 With Jason Kelce? She Says...
text:
Jason Kelce's Wife Kylie Kelce Weighs In on Idea of Baby No. 5 
 News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Is Kylie Kelce Ready for Baby No. 5 With Jason Kelce? She Says...
 Kylie Kelce—mom to daughters Wyatt, 7, Elliotte, 5, Bennett, 3, and Finnley, 19 months, with husband Jason Kelce—addressed whether she's considering expanding their family once more: "We enjoy chaos."
 By Paige Catton Nov 08, 2026 1:20 AM | Updated 12 hours ago Tags Celeb Kids Couples Celebrities Jason Kelce Kylie Kelce Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Is Kylie Kelce Ready for Baby No. 5 With Jason Kelce? She Says... Kylie Kelce is not gonna lie about her thoughts on adding another player to her team.
 The 34-year-old—who shares daughters Wyatt , 7, Elliotte , 5, Bennett , 3, and Finnley , 19 months, with husband Jason Kelce —weighed in on the possibility of having a fifth baby in the future.
 “It’s funny,” Kylie shared on the Nov. 4 episode of her Not Gonna Lie podcast when her guest Joanna Gaines asked if she’d be open to having more kids. “That was one of the questions that we talked about.”
 As a mom of five herself, Joanna—who shares kids Drake , 21, Ella , 20, Duke , 18, Emmie , 16, and Crew , 8, with husband Chip Gaines —encouraged Kylie to have one more kid.
 “Five is a good number,” the Fixer Upper star noted to Kylie, who asked, “Is it?”
 “And it’s gonna be a boy,” Joanna added. “I think you should do it.”
 While Kylie laughed at the interior designer’s quip about the possibility of having a boy after four girls, she appeared intrigued, especially when Joanna noted that she thinks Kylie and Jason—who married in 2018—“thrive in chaos.”
 “We do,” Kylie admitted. “We enjoy chaos.”
 read Travis Kelce Reveals What Kylie Kelce Would Say "F--k You" to Him Over “You think one more?” the podcast host asked Joanna with a smile, to which the HGTV star  replied, “Yes, obviously, give it some time.”
 “Kylie, bust it out, five,” she continued, adding further encouragement. “It’s gonna be your little boy and it's gonna rock your world because it's totally different than girls and it's another spot in your heart. Or if it's a girl, great, ‘cause five girls is a party house.”
 And Kylie couldn’t help but highlight that the number five does have quite the ring to it, especially in sports terms.
 After all, she noted, “It's a starting five, isn't it?”
 Although the Not Gonna Lie host didn’t give a direct answer about expanding her and Jason’s team, she did make it clear that she was taking Joanna’s words to heart.
 “OK, if we have a fifth child, I'm gonna come right back to this moment right here,” Kylie shared with a laugh, before joking, “‘Jo did it!’”
 Mike Coppola/Getty Images for SiriusXM But Joanna ended the topic by throwing in one last play.
 As she told Kylie, “Let me do the nursery!”
 While time will tell what the future holds, Kylie didn’t hesitate to tackle the bodyshamers who speculated she was expecting over the summer after she shared photos from a trip to Paris.
  “Stop trying to get me to have more. Stop it,” she stressed on a July 30 episode of Not Gonna Lie . “That's between me, my husband, and my motherf--king uterus.”
 As she emphasized, “Even if, which I am not, even if I was with child, that is between me and my husband to decide when we would like to share that information.”
 For a closer look at Kylie and Jason’s huddle of six, keep reading…
 Instagram Baby on Board
 In October 2019, Jason Kelce and Kylie Kelce welcomed their first baby together, a daughter named  Wyatt Elizabeth Kelce. 
 Instagram/@kykelce Family of Four
 Their second daughter Elliotte Ray Kelce joined the family two years later.
 Instagram/@kykelce Party of Five
 One year after Elliotte's arrival, Kylie shared that " another Kelce lady " would be added to the bunch with an adorable set of photos.
 Kylie Kelce/Instagram Happy Halloween
 On Halloween 2022, Jason and a then-pregnant Kylie dressed up as Piglet and Kanga, respectively. Meanwhile, their girls were Tigger and Winne the Pooh.
 Instagram/@kykelce Meet Bennett
 In February 2023, the couple welcomed their third child, with her arrival coming nearly two weeks after Jason faced off against brother Travis Kelce  at the 2023 Super Bowl .
 Instagram/@jason.kelce Golden Girls
 Jason shared a glimpse at his oldest daughters holding a huge prize in May 2023, writing on Instagram, "Never in a million years did I think I’d hold the Larry O’Brien trophy, let alone that it would be in my house!!"
 "Unbelievable honor to see it in person," he continued. "The size is incredible, looks so small when NBA players are holding it, but it’s actually massive!! The girls were very interested in it."
 Instagram/@kykelce Perfect Teammates
 The family of five hit the field in August 2023 , with Kylie joking in an Instagram post, "Here for the Rita’s and obstacle courses with dad after practice."
 Instagram/Kylie Kelce Fly, Eagles Fly
 Jason and Kylie rang in Wyatt's fourth birthday in October 2023 on the Philadelphia Eagles' home turf. As Kylie noted on Instagram , "We were celebrating a 4th birthday when the Birds went 4-0."
 Instagram / Kylie Kelce Lucky Charms
 Kylie shared this pic of Wyatt, Elliotte and Bennett on Instagram in June 2024, writing, "Parents know… 2 out of 3 isn’t bad!"
 Jason's mom  Donna Kelce commented, "The cutest beautiful bunch of 'lucky charms' under that rainbow!!!!"

 Jason and Kylie welcomed their fourth baby girl Finnley "Finn" Anne Kelce on March 30, 2025.
 Instagram Mom and Me
 Kylie craddled her Finn in her arms after the baby's March 2025 arrival.

 Little Finn rocked a floral onesie shortly after she was born in the hospital.
